title: Vented ENCLOSURE™ for Compounding and Powder Weighing
meta_title: Vented Enclosures for Powder Weighing and Compounding | Air Science
meta_description: Vented ENCLOSURE™ offer important safety features for containment of powders and fumes during compounding or weighing. Custom sizes, turbulent-free airflow, and HEPA filtration.
meta_keywords: vented enclosure, powder weighing, compounding, fume containment, HEPA filtration, custom sizes
short_description: Ideal for containment of powders and fumes during compounding or weighing, Vented ENCLOSURE™ offer important safety features that are not found with any other competitive products.
full_description: Custom sizes to meet every need. Turbulent-free airflow pattern. Proven performance. Specialized HEPA filter technology for increased safety. Ductless design increases location possibilities.
seo_content: Vented ENCLOSURE™ are designed for safe containment of powders, dusts, and fumes during critical compounding and weighing operations. With custom sizing, turbulent-free airflow, and advanced HEPA filtration, these enclosures provide unparalleled protection and flexibility for a wide range of laboratory and industrial applications.

Protection & Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.

Airflow & Filtration.Main Filter: HEPA and/or Carbon; Bag-out version available.
